name: autopilot
description: Drives your Claude Code sessions on its own: asks you pointed questions first when a prompt leaves the goal, constraints or check unclear, rewrites a session's first prompt, decides permission asks from the whole conversation and Claude's questions once you've gone quiet, and after each turn sends the practical next step (fix, verify, commit on a branch) until only you can decide what is left, the push and the PR included.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The model that rewrites a session's first prompt, and judges whether a session's first prompt needs questions: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id. Permission asks, questions and the next step are decided by the session's own model over the whole conversation.

maxTurns.title: Turn cap
maxTurns.description: The most turns autopilot starts on its own for one goal before it stops and notifies you.

autoEngage.title: On in every session
autoEngage.description: On (default): every prompt you type becomes the goal and the session drives itself, deciding permission asks for you. Off: engage per session with /drive.
